title: Frontend Engineer
description: Job Description: Front-End Engineer Experience: 3–5 Years Location: HSR Layout, Bengaluru About the company Zeitgeist Retail Private Limited (ZRPL) is an E-Commerce Technology and Services company, headquartered in Bengaluru, India. The company provides ZEPP, an API platform for enterprises. Role Overview We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Front-End Engineer with 3–5 years of experience in building responsive, high-performance, and user-friendly web applications. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with modern front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, and Next.js, along with practical experience in Magento UI development. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining customer-facing eCommerce storefronts, translating UI/UX designs into functional interfaces, and ensuring performance, responsiveness, and consistency across devices and browsers. Key Responsibilities Develop, enhance, and maintain responsive front-end applications for eCommerce platforms. Build and customize storefront interfaces using React.js, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript. Implement and customize Magento front-end components, themes, layouts, and UI elements. Convert Figma designs and UI/UX wireframes into pixel-perfect, responsive web interfaces. Optimize website performance, page loading speed, and overall user experience. Ensure cross-browser and cross-device compatibility. Integrate front-end applications with REST APIs and GraphQL services. Collaborate with backend developers, UI/UX designers, QA engineers, and product teams. Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve front-end issues and performance bottlenecks. Follow coding standards, reusable component architecture, and version control practices. Maintain code quality through debugging, testing, and documentation. Required Technical Skills Core Front-End Technologies ● Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+). ● Hands-on experience with React.js and Next.js. ● Strong understanding of responsive web design and CSS frameworks. ● Experience with component-based architecture and state management. Magento Development ● Practical experience with Magento 2 front-end development. ● Understanding of Magento themes, layouts, templates, and UI components. ● Knowledge of Magento frontend architecture, LESS/CSS, and JavaScript customization. ● Familiarity with PWA Studio or headless Magento architecture is an added advantage. API & Development Tools ● Experience integrating REST APIs and GraphQL. ● Familiarity with Git and version control workflows. ● Understanding of browser developer tools and debugging techniques. ● Knowledge of website performance optimization and SEO fundamentals. Preferred Qualifications ● Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. ● Experience working on enterprise or D2C eCommerce storefronts. ● Familiarity with Figma and design-to-development workflows. ● Understanding of accessibility standards and web security fundamentals. ● Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based deployment environments. Required Competencies ● Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. ● Excellent attention to detail and visual consistency. ● Ability to translate business and design requirements into technical solutions. ● Good communication and collaboration skills. ● Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. ● Proactive approach to learning and adopting new technologies. We have committed to achieving net zero by 2040.

We recognize the impact that a business like ours can deliver in elevating communities globally, and we continue to improve our efforts and take decisive actions that benefit the communities in which we work and live. Through the HCL Foundation, the CSR arm of HCLTech, we have invested more than $130 million in social development efforts serving communities throughout India across education, health, water, sanitation and hygiene, skill development and livelihoods, environment, and disaster risk reduction, response and management.

We’re powered by our people – a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 167 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

Consolidated revenues as of 12 months ending September 2026 totaled $14.8 billion. To learn how we can supercharge progress for you, visit hcltech.com.

description: #RunwiththePack At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk . Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. What we build is used broadly enough that good decisions scale well and poor ones surface quickly. We're looking for a Full Stack Developer who is energized by that kind of leverage. This role requires deep expertise in React, TypeScript , and good experience and interest with Backend services(Go, Node js…) including building Backend for Frontend layers, along with a strong focus on engineering excellence, performance, scalability, and developer experience. You’ll be expected to demonstrate frontend best practices and architectural patterns, and help drive operational excellence across our frontend systems. Responsibilities As a Full Stack Developer at Arctic Wolf, you will: Design and develop scalable, high-performance frontend architectures and Portals using React and TypeScript. Investigate systemic issues across the platform - audit unfamiliar codebases, identify root causes, and produce written findings and architectural recommendations before proposing solutions. Build and maintain Node.js /Go - based backend services supporting frontend platforms (e.g., BFFs, APIs, tooling services). Contribute to Agile development processes including sprint planning, retrospectives, and iterative delivery practices. Contribute to long-term technical strategy through written proposals and cross-team architecture conversations. Required Qualifications 3+ years of software development experience. Strong Fundamentals in HTML, CSS, Javascript and Web Architectures. Strong expertise in TypeScript and React (hooks, state management, performance). Monorepo experience at scale (we use Nx — familiarity with task graphs and affected builds is a plus). Server-state management and client-side routing in a large React application. Hands-on experience with Node.js and backend service development including Go. Experience with testing infrastructure : unit, component, and E2E (Vitest, Playwright, or equivalents). Demonstrated ability to independently investigate a complex codebase and produce clear written architectural assessments - not just code fixes. Ability to balance ideal architecture with real-world constraints, adapt quickly to changing priorities, and effectively context-switch across multiple initiatives when urgent platform needs arise. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with: Design systems and component libraries (Storybook, etc.) Monorepos (Nx, Turborepo, Lerna) CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions or similar) TanStack Query and Router Deep understanding of: Web performance optimization Cross-browser compatibility Accessibility (a11y) best practices Experience building developer tools (CLI tools, plugins, linters, codemods) Experience with frontend build tools and bundlers (Webpack, Vite, Rollup, etc.) Strong knowledge of API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL) Knowledge of SSR/SSG frameworks (Next.js or similar) Exposure to micro-frontend architectures Cloud experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP) Strong understanding of observability and monitoring tools , Ex: Sentry On-Camera Policy To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2025), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024-2026), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024-2026). As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry. You will work closely with product managers and designers and proactively share your own knowledge of frontend technologies and practices with the wider team. We are looking for someone with 7+ years of professional experience in frontend engineering. Proficiency in English, written and verbal, is required. We value humility and collaboration. We are looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos. We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code, including tests, documentation, and long-term code quality. Location: Bangalore, India. This is a hybrid role, three days per week in the office. Required Skills 7+ years of professional experience in software development for scalable, web-based applications. Proficiency in English, written and verbal, is required. Core languages & frameworks Strong TypeScript (strict) and modern JavaScript (ES Modules, async). Deep React experience (hooks, composition, performance); React 19 / React Compiler a plus. Solid HTML5, CSS3, and responsive/accessible UI fundamentals. Build & tooling Modern build tooling Vite (or Webpack/Rollup); code splitting and bundle optimization. Git and pull-request workflows; monorepo experience (Nx) a plus. Linters/formatters (Biome, ESLint/Prettier) and CI discipline. State & data State management with Redux Toolkit, XState (state machines), and/or TanStack Query. RxJS / reactive streams. Consuming REST APIs; JWT/OAuth2 bearer auth on the client; robust error handling. Styling & design systems Tailwind CSS, MUI (Material UI), styled-components/Emotion. Working with a design-token system for brand consistency. Data grids & performance Complex data grids (ag-Grid Enterprise preferred, or TanStack Table/Handsontable): virtualization, server-side row model, custom renderers/editors. Frontend performance profiling and optimization (rendering, memoization, main-thread work). Web Workers for off-main-thread compute. Accessibility & i18n WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA accessibility practices; ARIA, keyboard, focus management. Internationalization (i18next or similar), including locale-aware date/number formatting. Testing & quality Unit/component testing (Vitest/Jest + Testing Library), API mocking (MSW), and Playwright E2E. Secure client-side coding against the OWASP Top 10 (XSS, token handling, safe storage). AI Tooling Productive use of AI-assisted developer tooling (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate day-to-day frontend development. Building AI-assisted / generative-AI UX: in-app copilots, natural-language querying, or smart suggestions surfaced to the user. Integrating LLM APIs on the client (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock) with streaming/token-by-token rendering, cancellation, and graceful error/loading states. Soft skills Strong problem-solving abilities and an eagerness to learn. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well in a team. Storybook and visual regression testing. New Relic browser RUM, Pendo, and web-vitals (INP/FPS) instrumentation. Experience meeting enforced performance budgets and SLOs in CI. Domain knowledge in finance, ERP, FP&A, budgeting, or spreadsheet-like applications. Designing accessible, trustworthy AI interaction patterns, such as citations, confidence indicators, and human-in-the-loop review for sensitive outputs. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and maintain new features for our SaaS platform, applying a broad knowledge of frontend principles and practices to difficult assignments. Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code, and act as a source of technical guidance in code reviews and best-practice discussions. Mentor and coach junior members of the development team. Debug and resolve issues reported by users or identified in the production environment. Improve the performance, scalability, and security of the platform. Implement and maintain automated tests to ensure software reliability. Work closely with the design team to ensure the platform is user-friendly and follows UI/UX best practices. Partner effectively with product, design, and engineering peers to deliver assigned work. Stay up-to-date with the latest trends in web development and cloud-based SaaS technologies.

Observability & Telemetry Engineering: Lead the implementation and optimisation of enterprise observability solutions using Dynatrace, Splunk, PagerDuty and OpenTelemetry. Conduct regular one-on-ones, establish performance objectives, support career development, facilitate technical upskilling and build a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous learning. Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with Platform Managers, Product Owners, Principal Engineers, Architects, Scrum Masters, Cyber Security and SRE teams. Build strong relationships with business stakeholders and external technology partners to align engineering priorities with enterprise platform objectives and business outcomes. What you'll bring Hands-On Engineering Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading software engineering, platform engineering or observability teams within enterprise Agile environments. Ability to combine technical authority and architectural understanding with pragmatic delivery execution. Enterprise Platform Expertise: Strong technical experience in at least one of the following domains: ServiceNow Enterprise Platform (ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, CSDM), Observability platforms (Dynatrace, Splunk, OpenTelemetry) or enterprise IT operations and automation ecosystems. ServiceNow Engineering: Practical experience with ServiceNow platform development, scripting, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, Service Catalog, CMDB, CSDM, Automated Test Framework (ATF) and enterprise integrations, particularly for candidates specialising in ServiceNow engineering. ITOM & AIOps Engineering: Understanding of event management, service mapping, automated discovery, intelligent event correlation, alert management and operational remediation workflows. Observability & Monitoring: Hands-on experience with observability and telemetry platforms such as Dynatrace, Splunk, PagerDuty and OpenTelemetry, including monitoring architecture, distributed tracing, log analytics and performance optimisation. DevSecOps & CI/CD Engineering: Strong understanding of Git-based development, automated CI/CD pipelines, REST/GraphQL APIs, containerised environments, automated security scanning, Infrastructure as Code and Service Management as Code practices. Agile Delivery & Engineering Metrics: Proven ability to lead Scrum/Kanban delivery, facilitate sprint ceremonies, manage technical backlogs, perform effort estimation and optimise engineering throughput using DORA metrics and delivery performance indicators. Quality Engineering & Automation: Experience establishing automated testing frameworks, regression testing, code quality standards, release governance and automated deployment controls to ensure reliable production releases. Site Reliability & Operational Excellence: Understanding of SRE principles, incident management, root cause analysis, performance optimisation, platform health monitoring and operational reliability within complex enterprise environments. People Management & Team Development: Demonstrated ability to manage, mentor and develop engineering teams, establish performance objectives, conduct talent reviews and foster an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing engineering culture. Stakeholder Management & Communication: Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with Product Owners, Architects, Platform Managers, business teams and distributed engineering squads across locations. Career Experience: 7+ years of progressive software or platform engineering experience, including at least 24 years of demonstrated experience leading, mentoring or managing engineering teams within complex enterprise environments. A proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade platform capabilities, API integrations, automated testing pipelines or observability solutions. Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related quantitative discipline. Certifications (Desirable): ServiceNow: Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Developer (CAD) or Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in ITSM, Discovery, Event Management or Service Mapping. Observability: Dynatrace Certified Professional, Splunk Certified Administrator or Google Cloud certifications. Agile & IT Service Management: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe Practitioner or ITIL v4 Foundation.
